candidate.rationale: Third untried candidate after reading all seven complete captured artifact records, inline protocol, baseline and both real evaluations: retain the width-only action and change only repair_margin from 0 to 10. Candidate 2 reports cell_area_um2=161973, setup_slack_ns=0.105414, hold_slack_ns=0.122652, electrical_violations={max_slew:16,max_cap:6,max_fanout:0}, failure_classes=[electrical], physical_qualified=false and rank_eligible=false. Its energy_j is empty and measurement_qualified and score are absent, so no qualified Q can be calculated. Increasing the frozen repair_margin by one domain step targets this observed electrical failure while limiting potential buffer/sizing area and power overhead relative to margin 20. Closure and timing preservation are hypotheses; no raw violating-net or critical-path evidence establishes the necessary margin. Keep utilization=40, density=0.55 and abc_area=0 to avoid confounding this repair experiment and retain the positive reported timing headroom. Keep protocol-proved reduce_width=true for exact signed 18-bit reduction sign extended to 32 bits with unchanged cycles; its capacitance/energy opportunity is unmeasured and its latest area is actually 19 um2 above baseline. Keep operand_isolation=false: candidate 1 with both actions at margin 0 had area 160081, setup/hold slack -0.0262439/0.0945523 ns, no electrical violations, and failure_classes=[physical_execution,timing]. This comparison does not establish isolation as the critical-path cause. Forgoing isolation also forgoes its idle-multiply switching suppression. Two accepted evaluations are captured and continue_search=true; this unseen full tuple uses the third and last candidate slot. Elapsed search times 3431.9686764859944 and 7473.467817406985 s do not establish remaining time in the separate shared 1200-second agent budget; EDA wait is separate. Preserve both failures and their total_wall_seconds=3309.008427767025 and 3888.7651987310383, including recorded physical/postprocess costs, and baseline total_wall_seconds=3551.9976408449584. Baseline remains the best qualified result: cell area 161954 um2, setup/hold slack 0.19292/0.114491 ns, zero electrical violations and Q=1.0. Rank only physically and measurement-qualified results using Q=(cell_area_um2/161954)*geometric_mean(E_DOT64/2.293945631906608e-7,E_GEMM8/1.7792685987008622e-6,E_CONV3/1.1542462882162743e-6), seeking Q<1.0 and then Q<=0.98; die area and timing estimates are not scoring inputs. Protected evaluation must report physical_qualified, measurement_qualified, rank_eligible, failure_classes, cell_area_um2, setup_slack_ns, hold_slack_ns, electrical_violations, all three energy_j and estimated_power_w values, activity_and_parasitic_annotation, area_ratio, energy_ratio, score, physical_manifest, postprocessing_commands and physical/postprocess/total wall-time costs. Retain the baseline unless genuine qualified measurements improve Q. Energy scope remains Liberty-model estimates from zero-delay post-route workload activity plus extracted SPEF over reset-deassertion to settled committed-tohost completion windows; no SDF/glitch-aware or silicon-energy claim. Prior reviews passed proposal validity and report interpretation, not physical closure. This proposal is unmeasured; validation does not run EDA or establish improvement.
